items.title: MECH-428/INV-086 waypoint_field_consumer_reach H1 (drive axis), ABSORPTION-GATED re-run: does the TRAINING SIGNAL convert field-perceivability into navigation, measured behind a paired absorption + conversion-capability readiness gate?
items.note:
H1 (drive/training-signal axis) of the GOV-FANOUT-1 two-leg waypoint_field_consumer_reach portfolio (registry qid waypoint_field_consumer_reach, hid H-wpfield-objective-sparsity). SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-1039: a same-question INSTRUMENT REPAIR, not a new hypothesis. AUTHORITY: the CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1039_2026-09-16 (user Step 8 gate 2026-09-16T13:06:22Z, applied by governance-20260916, REE_assembly db6d20ebee), section 14 items 1-5.

WHY A REPAIR. V3-EXQ-1039 returned PASS with a VACUOUS null: shaped_rl was bit-identical to sparse_rl on every recorded behavioural metric on all 3 seeds while carrying a training return two-plus orders of magnitude larger; demo_warmstart's final CE was 3.465736 = ln(32), exactly chance over num_candidates=32; the readiness gate built to catch that (C0d) passed at 0.667 while the head's output stayed at chance, because it tested a BOOLEAN weight-norm move plus LateralPFCAnalog.candidate_summary_degenerate -- a field only COMPUTED when rule_readout_consumer is on and k>=2, which defaults False on this recipe. So H1 is UNRESOLVED, not answered. 1039a makes ABSORBED (never reached a parameter) separable from COULD-HAVE-CONVERTED-AND-DID-NOT before any flat null is admissible.

WHAT IT DOES. Same arms (sparse_rl / shaped_rl / demo_warmstart + greedy_oracle / random_walk anchors), same DV (waypoints_visited_per_ep), same BUDGET byte-identical to 1039 (20 zworld_p0 + 25 p0_warmup + 90 RL + 25 demo, 80 steps, seeds 42/43/44) -- autopsy item 5 forbids a power-bump before items 1-4 land, and this is not one. Ten CONJUNCTIVE readiness/premise gates precede any verdict criterion; every failure self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue naming the gate, never a substrate-verdict label. ABSORPTION: A1 shaped-vs-sparse P1 return separation in sd, A2 surviving-advantage fraction, A3 demo CE vs ln(mean n_candidates). CONVERSION CAPABILITY: B1 distinct first-action classes >= 3 on a strict majority of fresh E3 ticks, B2 eval-side bias-head ablation changes at least one committed action on >= 2 of 3 seeds. Plus C0 oracle floor, C0b world-encoder trained, C0c achievable span, C0d bias-head weight-norm delta as a FLOAT on the worst cell (replacing 1039's boolean-on-a-majority), C0e the COMPUTED candidate-summary degeneracy fraction (replacing the vacuous flag), then R1/R2 and C1. criteria_non_degenerate for C1 is now absorption AND conversion-capability AND eval mobility (autopsy item 4), not mobility alone.

INSTRUMENT PROVENANCE (the chip asked which was done). 1039a CONSUMES the shared build sd-allon-training-signal-absorption-telemetry, which LANDED in experiments/_lib/allon_training.py (ree-v3 996dec30) after this work's 2026-09-16 pre-flight authorised driver-side instrumentation; it captures the absorption/conversion dicts returned by BOTH _train_all_on_agent calls per cell (the P0 warm call and the arm's P1 call), which is what makes 'recorded per arm and per phase' literal -- 1039 discarded both. It recomputes NONE of those statistics. The single driver-side addition is a per-E3-tick distinct-first-action-class histogram, needed because the ratified gate is a MAJORITY (median/quantile) statement that the shared block's n/mean/sd/min/max cannot express; it is a read-only pass-through on the shared helper, restored in a finally, no RNG draw.

USER-RATIFIED AMENDMENT 2026-09-18 (AskUserQuestion, option B) -- precondition A2 is quantified over A2_GATED_ARMS (shaped_rl only), NOT over every treatment cell as the autopsy's section 14 item 1 literally said; sparse_rl's and demo_warmstart's surviving-advantage fractions are RECORDED under the precondition's ungated_arms_surviving_frac instead of gated. Reason: the REINFORCE advantage is ep_return - EMA_baseline (EMA_DECAY 0.9), so after one 0.2 waypoint visit the baseline decays below ADV_MIN_THRESHOLD within ~14 reward-free episodes and a BLOCKED sparse_rl's terms are skipped BY CONSTRUCTION -- 1039 recorded sparse_rl@seed44 at 0.0 visits/ep. Under the original quantifier the result 'the sparse signal produced no gradient, the dense one did, and behaviour still did not move' -- a genuine H1-negative finding and the single most likely outcome -- would have self-routed to substrate_not_ready_requeue, an instrument label on the manipulation's own CONTROL regime. The gate's purpose is unchanged: if shaped_rl shows no surviving advantage, nothing in this design could have converted. demo_warmstart is excluded structurally (same unshaped env as sparse_rl, so its absorption evidence is A3). The same decision DECLINED option C (no lpfc_bias_saturated_frac ceiling -- it stays recorded, not gated) and option D (e3.e3_score_decomp_enabled stays OFF).

STEP 4.5 RED-TEAM (fable 5.1, cross-model, one pass): CONTESTED -- 5 findings, all verified against source before disposition. FIXED here: F5, the per-tick tap counted env steps rather than fresh E3 selections because allon_training calls _distinct_first_action_classes every P1 step while agent.generate_trajectories returns the SAME cached _committed_candidates object between E3 ticks -- a MEASURED 5x pseudo-replication (30 env steps, 6 real selections, 24 held) that had been hold-weighting the ratified 'majority'; fixed by identity-deduplicating the cached object, with n_held_ticks recorded so the denominator stays auditable. F1-recording and F4: now recorded per fresh tick are lpfc_bias_abs_mean against lateral_pfc.config.bias_scale, lpfc_bias_saturated_frac, and modulatory_shortlist_size. F1-gate, F2 and F3 amended a user-ratified gate set and were escalated as decision chip chip-20260918-exq1039a-readiness-gate-amendment, resolved as above. MEASURED IN THE SMOKE, not predicted: lpfc_bias_saturated_frac = 1.000 in all three treatment arms (bias_abs_mean 0.10000000894 == bias_scale 0.1 to float precision) -- the hard-clamp branch taken when rule_readout_consumer is False has exactly zero gradient there, which is the mechanism behind shaped_rl's head weight-norm delta of exactly 0.0 sitting beside adv_surviving_frac = 1.0. At the dry budget the heads are near initialisation so this is not a full-scale result, but it is why the statistic is now recorded. Full findings, measurements and option table: REE_assembly 6cfe46fb65 evidence/planning/exq1039a_absorption_gate_redteam_staged_20260918.md.

TWO DEFECTS FOUND BY THIS SESSION'S OWN SMOKE, both fixed. (1) capture_head_diagnostics=True is SILENTLY SWALLOWED by REEConfig.from_dims -- it neither raises nor sets an attribute; the correct key is lateral_pfc_capture_head_diagnostics (agent.py:1006 reads that and passes it into LateralPFCConfig). Until fixed, absorption.hidden_dead_relu_frac_available came back False with n=0, i.e. autopsy item (d) was not recorded at all. A construction-time assert now prevents a silent regression. (2) Precondition A1's separation denominator used only the sparse arm's SD, measured at exactly 0.0, so it divided by epsilon and reported 3000000.0; now max(sparse_sd, shaped_sd, EPS) with a declared cap, and the same cell reads 1.38873.

GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is the paired absorption/conversion readiness block alongside visits/ep. V3-EXQ-1039's own manifest (substrate_hash 5a74d5279d7c7753d4ccd34d281bc89d798c04162899d40db7f97ecdc1ea0884) carries NONE of absorption, conversion, adv_surviving_frac, distinct_first_action_classes or candidate_summary_degenerate_computed -- the telemetry build post-dates it; and the 1039 autopsy's own check against v3_exq_884 / v3_exq_1030 / v3_exq_1004 found 0/3 carrying even the behavioural readout. The build also edits experiments/_lib/**, which is inside substrate_hash, so no prior run is substrate-compatible by construction. NOT RECOVERABLE -> run.

SUBSTRATE GATES. Re-derive brake (2.5b, re-checked at write time): INV-086 = 0 counted autopsies, MECH-428 = 1 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-884_2026-08-03) -- both below threshold 2, does not fire. Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap: SD-082's substrate_paths is EMPTY on origin/master as of 261660bfa3 (user decision 2026-09-18T18:50:48Z option A; GFLAG-0347 + GFLAG-0333 resolved), confirmed an ancestor of HEAD -- the block that refused the first attempt is gone. The remaining open corrupting entries were probed EMPIRICALLY on the exact agent this driver builds, not argued by shape: contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy is NOT REACHABLE -- sd016_writepath_mode is absent from this recipe's config so agent.py:5492 takes the OFF branch, a 12-tick probe recorded ContextMemory.write() CALLS = 0, contextmemory_write_addressing_loss_weight and sd016_diversification_weight are both 0.0, and 1039a's DVs read the ContextMemory bank nowhere; use_blocked_agency = False (agent.blocked_agency is None), use_selection_entropy_floor = False (module None), and agent.tonic_vigor is None (MECH-320). ACKNOWLEDGED DEGRADING OVERLAPS, run proceeds under them: sd-allon-training-signal-absorption-telemetry (the very block this driver consumes; its substrate_queue entry still reads build_owed although the build has landed), SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY, SD-018, SD-106, SD-091, SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING, SD-MECH267-CEM-SELECTION-FIX.

CLAIMS: INV-086 and MECH-428 tagged READ-ACROSS ONLY, evidence_direction_per_claim = non_contributory for both UNCONDITIONALLY -- this design exercises neither claim's own what_would_answer regime (no z_goal ablation for INV-086's WM-decay/feedback-channel regime; no forced-seed control for MECH-428's seeding-sparse z_goal_norm regime), and the reward-driven learning trains the lateral-PFC bias head and OFC devaluation head, NOT E3's own scoring-head parameters. experiment_purpose diagnostic: promotes and demotes nothing, routes to /failure-autopsy for adjudication. Hypothesis space: the leg waypoint_field_consumer_reach:H-wpfield-objective-sparsity stays ALIVE; hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json is NOT edited here (single producer is /failure-autopsy Step 9b). An evidence_discrepancy governance flag is raised alongside this entry so /governance can set V3-EXQ-1039's manifest evidence_direction: superseded once 1039a lands (its existing non_contributory stamp is left alone).

SMOKE: validate_experiments.py --strict OK, 0 non-conforming (1 advisory anchor-reachability warning left unexempted, as V3-EXQ-1039/1030 did for a first-of-lineage statistic). --dry-run completed rc=0 end-to-end on all 5 arms, manifest correctly relocated under dry_run=True, z_goal_stream wired (active_frac=0.000 with writer_calls=150 -- the expected reading, not a defect), label substrate_not_ready_requeue at the dry budget, which is the correct self-route. Post-amendment smoke re-run confirms adv_surviving_frac_clears_floor now MET at 1.0 on shaped_rl@seed42 with sparse_rl and demo_warmstart recorded at 0.0 as ungated telemetry. NOTE ON THE BARS: LIFT_MARGIN_FRAC, RETURN_SEPARATION_SD, ADV_SURVIVING_FRAC_FLOOR and DEMO_CE_CHANCE_FRAC are span- or sd-relative and self-calibrating to this run's own anchors rather than absolute literals, because no piloted effect size exists at this budget -- stated plainly rather than presented as pilot-verified.

items.title: MECH-017 additive-budget replay, BOTH pass orders: is the recency cost intrinsic, or an artefact of reallocation -- with pass order controlled?
items.note: MECH-017, SUCCESSOR to the V3-EXQ-1057 gate-out, with CONSOLIDATION PASS ORDER promoted to an explicit factor. Same ratified question (V3-EXQ-1048's confirmed autopsy, learning_extracted[0]): is the recency deficit INTRINSIC to replay, or an artefact of REALLOCATING a fixed gradient budget? | WHY A SECOND ITERATION. V3-EXQ-1057 RAN (manifest v3_exq_1057_..._20260918T211119Z_v3.json) and gated out cleanly: 14/15 preconditions green, the failure being additive_arm_retains_replay_gain at 0/5 against a threshold of 4. Its ARM_D ran the whole-buffer pass FIRST and the recent-window pass LAST, and the recorded per-seed numbers show the arm tracking its LAST pass -- D/B late ratios 0.95-1.11 (i.e. B-like) while A/B late ran 1.09-1.95, and on the EARLY probes D came in 11%-28% WORSE than B itself even though A beat B by 40-50% on 5/5. Critically, on the LATE probes that same arm was within LATE_TOL of B on 4/5 seeds, so the load-bearing C4 WOULD have passed and recorded 'recency cost is a reallocation artefact' off an arm that had lost replay entirely. The gate is what stopped that. So 1057 established that PASS ORDER MATTERS and left the ratified question open. | USER DECISION (real AskUserQuestion, 2026-09-18T22:58Z, on decision chip chip-20260918-mech017-arm-d-pass-order, verbatim): 'Let 1057 run, then C as successor if order matters.' Order matters (0/5, measured). This is that option C. | ARMS: the three V3-EXQ-1048 arms unchanged, plus BOTH additive-budget orders. ARM_D1_ADDITIVE_WHOLE_THEN_RECENT = 1057's ARM_D exactly (replay first), retained as the ORDER CONTROL so the contrast lives inside one run on one seed set. ARM_D2_ADDITIVE_RECENT_THEN_WHOLE = the reverse (replay last). Identical budget (2 x CMC_STEPS), identical windows, lr and schedule -- ONLY the order differs, which is what makes D1-vs-D2 a clean isolation of the ordering factor. | CRITERION, NOT INVENTED: load-bearing C4 is V3-EXQ-1048's C2 with ARM_D2 substituted for ARM_A -- same DV (e1_holdout_mse_late), same comparator arm B, same LATE_TOL=0.10, same SIGN_CONSISTENCY_REQUIRED=4. Read off D2 and not D1 because 1057 measured D1's order at 0/5 on replay-gain retention. C1/C2/C3 retained load_bearing:false. NO threshold in this script was introduced, moved or relaxed relative to 1057; the only structural change is the single ARM_D becoming two order arms, with the gain-retention gate evaluated PER ORDER ARM. | VERSIONING: LETTER not new number -- the scientific question is unchanged and the implementation had an uncontrolled factor, which is the policy's 'bug fix' branch. NO `supersedes` field, deliberately: the policy's supersedes mechanism exists to stop INVALID EVIDENCE weighting governance, and 1057 recorded evidence_direction `inconclusive` / substrate_not_ready_requeue, so it carries no claim weight to retire. Its finding (order matters; the D1 order is degenerate) is load-bearing FOR this design and must stay live. 1057 is CITED, not superseded. | PRECONDITIONS: all of 1048's and 1057's kept, none weakened or dropped. gradient_budget_matched still compares A vs B only. Per the dispatch instruction the gain-retention gate is evaluated PER ORDER ARM -- it GATES on D2 and is REPORTED-ONLY for D1, so a D1 gate-out cannot void D2 (gating on both would fire on D1 every time and destroy the comparison this run exists to make). | red-team (fable; model diversity from the authoring session's Opus 5): CONTESTED -> 4 findings, ALL verified against source, 3 FIXED and 1 declared-not-fixed with reason, 0 dismissed. G1 THE IMPORTANT ONE: the design guarded only ONE collapse direction -- the gate certified D2 is not B, but nothing certified D2 is not A, and for D2 that is the LIKELY collapse since its whole-buffer pass runs LAST and each consolidate() builds a fresh Adam (two overwrites, not one optimisation). D2 tracking A would clear the replay-gain gate trivially and then FAIL C4, recording 'recency cost is INTRINSIC to replay' / weakens when the real mechanism is 'the last pass wins, in either order'. A false `weakens` actively moves a claim, so this was the most consequential finding in either pass. FIXED with the symmetric gate additive_arm_retains_recency_benefit_d2 (e1_late(D2) < e1_late(A), same sign-count form, same majority constant); verified NON-CIRCULAR, since it asks D2 < A while C4 asks D2 <= 1.1xB and A sits 1.09x-1.95x above B on that leg. G2: the replay-gain gate was a strict sign count with NO margin while the criterion it protects has a 10% tolerance, so a D2 equal to B plus noise passes it by chance and then passes C4 trivially -- the very collapse 1057's gate existed to exclude, leaking back through the margin (the smoke sat at D2/B early = 1.0015). FIXED by transcribing this script's OWN pre-registered MIN_REL_GAIN_EARLY=0.05 (1048's C3 floor) as additive_replay_gain_clears_floor_d2. No new constant. G3 DECLARED NOT FIXED, with reason: probe-time LSTM dropout is live (e1_deep.py:648, num_layers default 3, no .eval(); torch.no_grad() does not disable dropout), giving ~0.8% arm-correlated DV noise (measured 0.03% untrained / 0.81% trained). NOT changed here because calling .eval() would break bit-comparability with V3-EXQ-1048 and V3-EXQ-1057, whose manifests are this design's prior and whose A/B/C cells it reproduces exactly; that is a substrate decision, not a successor experiment's. Mitigated instead by ensuring nothing is decided inside the band -- the 5% floor clears it ~6x and C4's 10% tolerance ~12x. Worth a substrate_queue entry. G4 WORDING FIXED: C1/C2/C3 were called 'replication'; they are not -- all 15 A/B/C cells of 1057 came back BIT-IDENTICAL to 1048's on the same machine_class (verified directly against both manifests), so on a fixed class they are a deterministic re-read, adding no independent confirmation. Corrected everywhere it appeared; the legs stay to pin the harness against drift and supply C4's comparator. | READING THE SMOKE: --dry-run uses ONE seed (seeds = (SEEDS[0],) if dry_run) while the seed-majority thresholds stay at 4, so EVERY sign-count precondition necessarily reads as unmet in a smoke. That is a scale artifact inherited from 1048/1057, not a prediction of failure. Substantively at toy scale D2 sat BETWEEN the parents -- additive_arm_retains_recency_benefit_d2 was satisfied per-seed (D2 late = 0.916 of A's), confirming the two gates are not jointly impossible -- while the replay-gain gate missed by 0.15%. D2's full-scale direction is genuinely unknown and both branches of C4 are live. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = e1_holdout_mse_late for the RECENT-then-WHOLE additive order. Never measured on any substrate -- 1048 has no additive arm and 1057 ran only the opposite order. NOT recoverable, run required. Step 2.5b re-derive brake on MECH-017 = 0 hits. Step 2.5c: the only open sleep-adjacent CORRUPTING entry (MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION) touches mel_consumer.py::relative_novelty and agent.py::run_sws_schema_pass, neither of which this driver calls; contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy is asserted OFF-PATH at runtime in all 25 cells. | V3-EXQ-1057 is a FAIL and is separately owed a /failure-autopsy pass; this entry cites it and does NOT adjudicate it. | PROVENANCE: validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings, all 37 checks) before and after the red-team fixes; --dry-run smoke run twice, 5/5 arms distinct, ARM_D1 bit-identical to 1057's ARM_D (1.45166e-4, a clean determinism check), both additive arms at extra_steps=32 = A(16)+B(16), windows labelled ALL->36 and 36->ALL. Script landed alone first as NOT QUEUED (ree-v3 c7dd9fd8).
